title: Pre-change compatibility goldens fingerprint receipt
generation_method: deterministic: sha256 over the sorted (localeCompare) canonical string built from live production sources; no wall-clock or random input feeds any hash.

fingerprint_algorithm.hash: sha256 hex digest over a UTF-8 canonical string
fingerprint_algorithm.tool_name_canonicalization: array of tool names sorted with String.prototype.localeCompare, joined with '|'
fingerprint_algorithm.rest_mapping_canonicalization: array of '<METHOD> <path>' sorted by path with localeCompare, joined with '|'
fingerprint_algorithm.reproduce_with: npx tsx <ad-hoc script importing buildToolRegistryEntries/getToolManifest/listRestApiToolMappings/listConvertedToolsWithOutputSchema and hashing per tool_name_canonicalization/rest_mapping_canonicalization>

note: This receipt is baseline evidence for Q4a. It may be updated only alongside an approved intentional-delta entry in config/ci/q4a-prechange-goldens.json (or config/ci/compatibility-rollback-envelope.json) that names which Wave 1/2 task caused the fingerprint to change.
